test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight persons, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at the corners while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of the sides of the table. C is sitting at one of the corners. F is to the immediate right of C. Only H is sitting between C and G. D is sitting at one of the corners. A is not sitting at any of the corners. E is to the immediate left of B. E is the immediate neighbour of F. Which two persons are sitting towards the left of G but to the right of B?
solution: Given: Eight persons, A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H, are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 1) C is sitting at one of the corners. 2) F is to the immediate right of C. 3) Only H is sitting between C and G.
